brief: On the canvas, taut stacks of brightly colored rubber bands are organized and held under visible tension. The pieces exhibit a slow, constant state of organized impermanence. Periodically, segments of the bands will slowly expand until the internal tension becomes too great, causing them to snap. This action generates a rhythmic series of visible releases, creating echoing, structured sequences of tension and sudden snap, which propagate across the arrangement. The overall movement is entirely self-contained and mechanical.

statement: This sketch depicts taut stacks of rubber bands arranged in a mechanical, self-contained system. Each band consists of ten segments that gently oscillate under tension, with subtle vertical motion creating the illusion of organized impermanence. The bands pulse rhythmically and occasionally snap when internal tension reaches a critical threshold, causing their segments to expand outward before snapping back into place. These rhythmic sequences of tension and release propagate across the arrangement in a structured, echoing pattern. The visual effect is created through simple geometric representation of each band's segments with dynamic tension visualization, producing a mesmerizing mechanical dance of elastic forces.
